description: This file contains SQL scripts for seeding baseline permissions and creating a helper function to seed standard roles per tenant within a multi-tenant account management platform. It defines permissions, a function to create roles with default permissions, and a trigger to automate role creation upon organization insertion.

methods.name: seed_standard_roles_for_tenant
methods.description: Creates default roles (Admin, Manager, Sales Rep, Viewer) for a given tenant and assigns appropriate permissions.

methods.name: trg_seed_roles_on_org_insert
methods.description: Trigger function that calls role seeding whenever a new organization is inserted.
